_comment: Optional CC0 / CC-BY assets. The game runs without any of them (procedural models, synthesized audio). Run `npm run fetch-assets` to download; files land next to this manifest. Audio ids 'sfx.<name>' replace the synthesized effect of the same name, ids starting with 'music.' form the playlist.
